# Render a valley drawing realistically

Keep layout and perspective while translating line work into materials and light.

**Original prompt · Reference edit · Not independently tested**

### Required inputs

- Upload the linked valley drawing or your own layout sketch.

Source reference images: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/drawings.webp)

<details>
<summary>Prompt</summary>



```text
Turn this drawing into a photorealistic image.
Preserve the exact layout, proportions, and perspective.
Choose realistic materials and lighting consistent with the sketch intent.
Do not add new elements or text.
```

[Browse the online gallery](https://image-2-5.com/gpt-image-2-5-prompts?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts&utm_content=detail--en--drawing-to-realistic-valley)

</details>

### Make it your own

Supply your own references, state the role of each, and separate what changes from what must stay.

### Notes

- Compare the river path, slopes and horizon against the sketch; this is visual design, not a surveyed landscape.
- Source settings: `size="1024x1536"`, `quality="medium"`.

**原始提示词 · 参考图编辑 · 尚未独立测试**

### 输入要求

- 上传下方山谷线稿，或自己的布局草图。

来源参考图: [1](https://developers.openai.com/images/platform/guides/image-prompting/drawings.webp)

<details>
<summary>提示词</summary>



```text
将这张绘画转成写实图像。
精确保留布局、比例和透视。
选择符合草图意图的真实材质与光照。
不要添加新元素或文字。
```

</details>

### 改成你的需求

提供自己的参考图，说明每张图的用途，并分清要修改与要保留的部分。

### 使用说明

- 对照草图检查河道、坡面与地平线；这是视觉设计，不是测绘地形。
- 来源参数：`size="1024x1536"`, `quality="medium"`.
